_meta.authored_by: QMDJ Chart Analyst (charter v7.0) interpretation layer
_meta.determinism_note: certainty is NOT written here. tools/validate_package.py computes it from the cited sets with the archetype_rubric certainty_formula, and tools/render_package.py emits the claim_line. The model never computes a score (law 39).

citation_roles.spine: structural E-atom with palace in {1,4,5}, or board_internal R-atom touching {1,4,5} (the 37-atom spine)
citation_roles.contrast: atom outside the spine, retained VISIBLE and ELIGIBLE (law 28) and cited as contrast only, never as ranked support
citation_roles.pillar: pillar-relation register atom (day-branch chong / liuhe / triad), tallied separately

implications.statement: At the source pole an alliance is formed and immediately taxed: the he-combination is entangled by the coiled spirit, and the life-gate presses on its own environment.
implications.rule: named-pattern composition (PAT-06 + PAT-05 + PAT-01 in one palace)
implications.note: the three markers are explicit; their composition is an inference, not a chart field

implications.statement: At the display pole the surface is fed by its environment while the nourishing core is stored: support arrives, but not from the visible layer.
implications.rule: PAT-02 + PAT-04 in one palace with a concealing deity
implications.note: both markers explicitly printed and both independently computed

implications.statement: The opposition pair 1-4 is generational, not antagonistic: the palace elements are water and wood, and water generates wood, so the two poles stand in a parent-child relation.
The centre's only stem is deposited into the display palace as a lodged stem, so the unexpressed core lands in the work that is shown rather than in the work that is argued.
implications.rule: lodging graph (centre builds a lodging GRAPH; law 10)
implications.note: centre has no opposite; this edge is the only source-derived lodging edge

implications.statement: The phase register is split by pole: the source pole holds peak-then-cut phases, the display pole holds gestating and growing phases.
implications.note: every phase claim in the source was re-derived from the frozen table and matched

implications.statement: Defect points concentrate on the hidden/instrument register: punishment marker, star tomb and gate pressure all sit on the concealed or stored layer.
implications.rule: PAT-03 + PAT-04 + PAT-01 convergence (three independent computations)
implications.note: this is the strongest negative structure on the axis

implications.statement: The command axis of the board sits off the primary axis and is itself pressed: the leading star is the tool/learning star, and its palace carries both gate pressure and a metal-on-wood breakage marker.
implications.rule: PAT-32 (值符/值使 anchor) + PAT-01 + PAT-23 as visible contrast (law 28)
implications.note: palace 8 is outside the ranked spine by case eligibility; it is cited as contrast and stays eligible for the red team

implications.statement: The three wonders circulate off-axis through the board's stem traces while the axis itself holds the receiving end, so the axis reads as a place where value arrives rather than originates.
implications.rule: CAP-09 stem value traces across palaces
implications.note: traces are computed from field values, never from array positions

claims.label: guarded_alliance
claims.interpretation_basis: The source pole forms a he-combination under a coiled-spirit marker while the life-gate presses against its own palace; the display pole is fed by its environment but keeps its nourishing star in tomb. Read together: the brand's core idea is a deliberate pact that stays guarded about its generosity.

counterevidence.why: core contention (庚加庚) argues the pact is unstable rather than guarded
punishment marker argues the alliance carries a penalty
the display pole receives support, which would read as a more open core

competing_candidates.label: quiet_craft_discipline
competing_candidates.why: 九地 + star-in-tomb support a quiet craft reading; it is not displaced by the pact evidence

competing_candidates.label: corrective_awakening
competing_candidates.why: requires an authority-rise or turnaround pattern on the spine; 青龙耀明/青龙转光 sit in palaces 7 and 9, outside the ranked scope, and no spine atom carries a turn

claims.decision_guard: State as tradition-conditional direction only. Do not phrase as a promise about market response (law 22).
claims.scope: primary axis {1,4} plus centre 5 lodging edge
claims.scenario_condition: holds while the brand's public voice remains narrower than its internal generosity
claims.validation_path: re-check against the Assignment-1 insight list: if a researched insight already claims 'generous' positioning, this claim is CONTRADICTS_KNOWN and must be reworked
limitations: interpretation is structural; no factual prediction is made
the he-combination's traditional gloss is register-level, not outcome-level

claims.label: precise_watchful
claims.interpretation_basis: Coiled spirit and life-gate sit under gate pressure at the source pole; depth and display sit together at the display pole with the centre's stem lodged into it. The voice register is exact and observant, warm only where the structure allows it.

counterevidence.why: the display pole is fed by its environment, which supports a warmer, easier voice
centre contention argues against a calm observer tone

competing_candidates.label: warm_directive
competing_candidates.why: supported by 宫生门 at the display pole; would need the life-gate to be unopposed, which it is not

competing_candidates.label: cool_withholding
competing_candidates.why: supported by 九地 and star-in-tomb; distinguished from this claim only by degree of warmth

claims.decision_guard: Voice adjectives must trace to a deity/gate/star atom in the shipped package, never to mood (no free invention).
claims.scenario_condition: holds where the brand speaks about its process rather than its effect
claims.validation_path: one line of voice copy drafted against C002; if the line promises an outcome, the line fails the guard, not the claim
limitations: tone register is the least fact-bound layer of the board; treat as creative direction

claims.label: ritual_mark
claims.interpretation_basis: Display gate with a deep-earth deity, a union combination, and a stored core: the name and mark should behave like a made object used in a repeated act, not like an announcement of authority.

counterevidence.why: an explicit rise-to-throne marker sits at the western palace (outside the ranked scope): a visible-authority direction is present on the board and stays eligible
a second explicit rise-to-throne marker at palace 3 is not confirmed by the chart's own definition (丙 sits in 震3, its home being 离9) — recorded as EXPLICIT_UNCONFIRMED
punishment marker argues the mark can misfire if it is overworked

competing_candidates.label: visible_authority
competing_candidates.why: explicitly supported outside the spine (palaces 3 and 7); legal contrast, not ranked

competing_candidates.label: engineered_softness
competing_candidates.why: no spine atom supports softening; tomb, punishment and pressure markers all point the other way

claims.decision_guard: A name or mark must never be 'selected by the chart'. The chart supplies register and constraint only; the choice traces to Assignment-1 (see C013, rejected).
claims.scenario_condition: holds while the mark is used in a repeated act rather than as a burst of signalling
claims.validation_path: logo direction must name 2-3 mood-board styles and one explicit avoid-line (brief requirement), each traced to Assignment 1
limitations: no literal object, place, or figure may be read off the chart (laws 23-24)

claims.label: sustained_care
claims.interpretation_basis: The life-gate stands at the source pole, the display pole carries the slow-earth star and keeps it in tomb, and the centre's stem is lodged into that same display palace. Structurally the product behaves as something kept and applied over time.

counterevidence.why: the concealed bright stem argues for an active, quick register rather than slow care
the bright value circulates across three palaces, which supports a dynamic reading

competing_candidates.label: contained_remedy
competing_candidates.why: supported by the star-in-tomb and the punishment marker: a small, concentrated format reading is legal

competing_candidates.label: restorative_rebuild
competing_candidates.why: requires a turnaround or authority-rise pattern inside the spine; none is present

claims.decision_guard: No medical, therapeutic or bodily claim may be derived (law 23). The star is used strictly as a registry term for a slow earth process.
claims.scenario_condition: holds while the product's value is expressed in repeated use rather than in a single effect
claims.validation_path: product definition (format, variants, size, price) is NOT chart-derivable: those rows carry NO_CHART_SUPPORT and must come from Assignment 1
limitations: product category is supplied by the case as scope only; the chart never names a product

case_alignment.note: price band is an Assignment-1 competitor-scan fact

claims.label: layered_reveal
claims.interpretation_basis: A concealing earth deity holds a display gate; the environment feeds that gate; the nourishing core is stored; the hidden brightness sits inside the same palace. The package should be composed in two states — a muted closed state and a warmer opened state.

counterevidence.why: punishment marker: the reveal can invert if the mechanism is over-engineered
the net-over-prison marker argues for restriction, i.e. a more closed treatment

competing_candidates.label: muted_shell_over_active_core
competing_candidates.why: supported by 九地 + star-in-tomb; differs from this claim only in whether the reveal is staged or simultaneous

competing_candidates.label: overt_signal_low_noise
competing_candidates.why: contradicted by the concealing deity and the stored star

claims.decision_guard: Material statements are creative direction only. No physical fact (substrate, finish, mechanism) may be asserted from the chart (laws 23-24).
claims.scenario_condition: holds while the first read is quiet and the second read rewards attention
claims.validation_path: shelf-standout element must be describable in one sentence from three feet away (brief requirement); tie it to one mood-board pin
limitations: the chart cannot specify colour; colour must come from the mood board and Assignment-1 insight

claims.label: opposition_led
claims.interpretation_basis: The two poles are a generative pair (water feeds wood) but their local conditions invert: agency presses on the environment at the source pole while the environment feeds agency at the display pole. The difference to lead with is that inversion, not a feature list.

counterevidence.why: the depth deity argues the difference could be led by layering rather than by opposition
the stored star supports a layer-led difference

competing_candidates.label: layer_led
competing_candidates.why: supported by 九地 + star-in-tomb; a legal second direction for Brief 2

competing_candidates.label: sequence_led
competing_candidates.why: sequencing is another archetype's jurisdiction (ARC-11) and would double-count one structure across two briefs

claims.decision_guard: The difference must be stated as a describable direction, never as 'better' (brief requirement).
claims.scope: primary axis {1,4} with the day-branch chong noted from the pillar register
claims.scenario_condition: holds while the category leads with performance claims that push against the environment
claims.validation_path: place the package beside the 3-5 researched competitors and state the inversion in one sentence
limitations: pillar-register relations are tallied separately and never absorbed into the spine count

claims.label: pressure_into_poise
claims.interpretation_basis: A pressed gate at the source pole, a fed gate at the display pole, a generative opposition between them, and a stored core in the display palace: the campaign idea is pressure resolved into composure.

counterevidence.why: punishment marker: composure may fail at the instrument layer
centre contention argues the idea's centre is unstable
the command axis is itself pressed, which limits any claim that the system is in control

competing_candidates.label: return_to_the_source
competing_candidates.why: the generative axis supports a return-to-source idea; distinguished from this claim by direction of travel

competing_candidates.label: the_quiet_instrument
competing_candidates.why: supported by star-in-tomb + punishment; a legal third direction

claims.decision_guard: The big idea must not promise an outcome or a result (law 22).
claims.scope: primary axis {1,4} plus centre lodging and the visible command-axis contrast
claims.scenario_condition: holds while the campaign shows the act rather than the result
claims.validation_path: hero image briefed from C008 and stage from C009 must both be derivable from this idea without a fourth, unrelated claim
limitations: no calendar or venue claim is made anywhere in this campaign direction

case_alignment.note: the big idea is what makes the three briefs read as one brand

claims.label: single_subject_soft_light
claims.interpretation_basis: A display gate under a concealing earth deity, with the slow-earth star in tomb: one subject, low and even light, focal weight on what is withheld rather than on what is displayed.

counterevidence.why: the impulse star argues for movement in frame
gate pressure argues for visible tension in frame

competing_candidates.label: object_only_ritual_frame
competing_candidates.why: strongly supported by star-in-tomb; would remove the human element entirely

competing_candidates.label: figure_in_pressure
competing_candidates.why: supported by the impulse star and gate pressure

claims.decision_guard: Composition language is creative direction. Nothing in this claim describes the world.
claims.scenario_condition: holds while the hero image is readable at thumbnail scale without any text
claims.validation_path: generate or shoot two frames (single subject; object-only) and test which one survives the 'no text' rule
limitations: no claims about the photographed person, body, or condition (law 23)

claims.label: enclosed_studio
claims.interpretation_basis: Depth deity, display gate fed by its palace, slow-earth star stored: an enclosed, low-ceilinged stage with a directional light source, rather than an open location.

counterevidence.why: the impulse star argues against a static enclosure
pressure at the source pole suggests the tension should be legible in the set

competing_candidates.label: threshold_interior
competing_candidates.why: an interior edge (door, sill, counter) is equally supported and keeps the 'act' visible

competing_candidates.label: open_field
competing_candidates.why: contradicted by the concealing deity, the stored star, and the slow-earth star

claims.decision_guard: Palace direction is contextual only; never state a real location (law 5).
claims.scenario_condition: holds while the set can be built in one controlled space with one motivated light
claims.validation_path: location scouting brief or AI prompt must contain: enclosure, single motivated light, one reserved negative space
limitations: the chart supplies register, not architecture

claims.label: hands_only
claims.interpretation_basis: The concealing deity and stored star put the human register behind the object register; the impulse star keeps movement in frame. Hands and gesture carry the act without a face.

counterevidence.why: the impulse star would also support a single figure in motion
the life-gate is a human-agency register and argues some presence is appropriate

competing_candidates.label: product_only
competing_candidates.why: legal and supported by star-in-tomb; removes all human presence

competing_candidates.label: one_calm_figure
competing_candidates.why: legal if the figure's stillness is motivated by the stored core

claims.decision_guard: No inference about any person, body, or condition is permitted; casting here is a stated creative choice (law 23).
claims.scenario_condition: holds while the campaign can be cast from hands and gesture alone
claims.validation_path: state the choice explicitly in the brief as a deliberate avoidance of faces, and give the reason
limitations: audience fit is a case-side judgement; the chart cannot confirm it

claims.label: core_first_then_context
claims.interpretation_basis: The display pole holds the gestating and growing phases while the source pole holds peak-then-cut phases. Build the supported, growing assets first; add the pressed life-register assets afterwards as the closing beat.

counterevidence.why: the peak phase at the source pole would justify leading with the strongest single image

competing_candidates.label: context_first_then_core
competing_candidates.why: the pressed life-gate could set up the display; legal if the story needs a problem first

competing_candidates.label: parallel_build
competing_candidates.why: the phase register is clearly split by pole, so a parallel build would ignore the only sequencing evidence the board offers

claims.decision_guard: Sequence claims cite phase atoms, not preference.
claims.scenario_condition: holds while the production run can hold the pressed-register assets to the end
claims.validation_path: asset list ordered: hero, then 2-3 supporting, then detail, then any motion — with the phase citation beside each block
limitations: the chart's own time units are not a delivery schedule

claims.label: hybrid_staged
claims.interpretation_basis: The defect points sit on the concealed/instrument layer; the command axis is off the spine and pressed; the display pole is the supported one. Proposal: stage the work in passes with a human gate at the instrument/punishment point, rather than committing a single automated chain.

counterevidence.why: the tool/learning star is the board's leading star: a tool-led production path is genuinely supported and must stay on the table
the metal-on-wood breakage marker at the command palace argues the tool chain fights its environment
gate pressure at the command palace argues for a human gate

competing_candidates.label: ai_led_human_gated
competing_candidates.why: supported by 天辅 as 值符; a legal alternative if the team accepts a human gate at the breakage point

competing_candidates.label: human_led_ai_assisted
competing_candidates.why: supported by the punishment marker; more conservative than proposed

claims.decision_guard: No budget, vendor, or schedule claim is made; the case states none and none may be inferred.
claims.scope: primary axis {1,4} with the visible command-axis contrast from {8}
claims.scenario_condition: holds while each pass has one named human approval point and a rollback
claims.validation_path: write the pass list with the approval gate marked at the pass that touches the concealed/instrument layer
limitations: the chart cannot select tools or vendors

case_alignment.note: the staged path is the production-realism contribution; the judgement itself is case-side

claims.label: chart_selected_name
claims.interpretation_basis: Draft claim (retained for the record): the chart's union marker and rise-to-throne markers 'select' a brand name.

counterevidence.why: the case's traceability requirement: every major decision must trace to a specific Assignment-1 research finding, insight, or mood-board pin — a chart-selected name can never do that

claims.decision_guard: Rejected. The chart supplies register and constraint; selection belongs to Assignment-1 evidence.
claims.validation_path: if a name candidate appears, it must be traced to a named insight or pin, then checked against C003's register, never the reverse

conflict_register.action: downgraded to rejected; the verdict was not rewritten to fit (law 52/cc3)

limitations: kept in the package deliberately: a rejection that is visible is stronger than a rejection that is silent

blocked_classes.reason: requires timeframe_of_interest; the case context declares no window and none may be inferred (law 40, cc5)
blocked_classes.structural_note: the board's own time frame is explicit and verified: year 丙午, month 丁酉, day 辛亥, hour 乙未, solar term 秋分 上元, 阴遁七局. This is a structural statement about the board, not a client window.

assumptions.statement: The slow-earth star is used strictly as a registry term for a slow earth process; no health, medical or bodily reading is derived from it.
assumptions.activating_condition: any claim that names a symptom, condition or treatment invalidates the reading and must be reworked

assumptions.statement: The three briefs are executed for a brand whose category can carry a restraint-led register.
assumptions.activating_condition: if Assignment-1 research shows the category is saturated with restraint, this assumption fails and the register must be re-argued

assumptions.statement: The palace 3 rise-to-throne / service / restraint markers are treated as visible contrast only, never as ranked support.
assumptions.activating_condition: if the operator re-earmarks the eligibility scope, those markers must be re-run through CAP-14 before any ranking

assumptions.statement: Pillar-register relations (day-branch chong / liuhe / triad) are reported and cited but never absorbed into the 37-atom spine tally.
assumptions.activating_condition: if a claim's support would depend only on pillar-register atoms, the claim is NO_CHART_SUPPORT for the spine and must be downgraded

assumptions.statement: The production path is a creative-direction proposal, not a vendor, budget or schedule decision.
assumptions.activating_condition: any cost, timeline or tool-selection statement requires a case-side input that does not exist in this run

red_team.finding: quiet_craft_discipline remains legal: 九地 + star-in-tomb read as craft discipline rather than guarded alliance. Distinguishing test: does the brand's public voice withhold generosity, or slow it down?
Rebutting C001 with centre contention (R018) fails: the centre's contention is intra-centre and its stem lands in the display palace (R047), which supports rather than refutes the alliance reading.

visible_authority (explicit rise-to-throne markers at palaces 3 and 7) is a legal contrast direction. It stays live because palace 7's marker is computed-confirmed while palace 3's is EXPLICIT_UNCONFIRMED.
muted_shell_over_active_core is legal and cheaper to produce than a staged reveal; the difference is only whether the second state is staged or simultaneous.
Rebutting C007 as 'the system is in control' fails: the command axis carries gate pressure and breakage markers, so no control claim survives.
product_only is legal and arguably stronger (star-in-tomb). hands_only survives because the impulse star keeps movement in frame; the two differ in whether a human trace is present at all.
context_first_then_core is legal. The ordering claim is the weakest live claim in the set; it should be presented to the producer as a preference with its phase citation, not as a finding.
ai_led_human_gated is legal: the board's leading star is the tool/learning star. It survives only if a human gate is placed exactly at the instrument/punishment layer.
Rebutting C004 with the circulating bright value (R037) fails: a circulating value is not a product format, and the product format is NO_CHART_SUPPORT regardless.
The rejected claim cannot be re-argued by adding chart support: the traceability requirement is a hard case constraint, and a chart-selected name fails it by construction.
cool_withholding is legal and only differs by degree of warmth; distinguishing test: does a sample line give a reason before an instruction?
layer_led remains legal: the depth deity plus the stored star would let Brief 2 lead with layering instead of the axis inversion.
object_only_ritual_frame is legal and stronger on the stored-star evidence; the two hero directions differ only in whether a human trace appears.
threshold_interior is legal: an interior edge keeps the 'act' visible and is cheaper to scout than a sealed studio.

brief_directives.directive: Write the core idea as a pact with a withheld interior: what the brand commits to, and what it deliberately keeps back.
Anchor the POV in the inversion on the axis: the category presses against its environment; this brand lets its environment feed the display.
brief_directives.guard: state as direction, never as superiority

brief_directives.directive: Audience and differentiator must be pulled from Assignment 1. The chart supplies only the register of the 'because' clause: supported display over pressed agency.
3-5 adjectives from the voice claim: exact, observant, unhurried, self-possessed, warm only where supported.
brief_directives.guard: each adjective maps to a cited atom

brief_directives.directive: Name choice is not chart-derived (C013 is rejected). Argue it from Assignment-1 evidence, then check it against the register in C003.
Brief a mark that behaves as a made object used in a repeated act; reference 2-3 mood-board styles and one explicit avoid-line.
brief_directives.guard: no literal object or figure from the chart

brief_directives.directive: Define format, variants, size and price from Assignment 1. The chart's contribution is the use-register only: value expressed over repeated use.
brief_directives.guard: NO_CHART_SUPPORT rows must be filled from Assignment-1 research

brief_directives.directive: Design a two-state package: a muted closed read, a warmer opened read, with the focal weight on the stored element.
brief_directives.guard: no material or colour asserted from the chart

brief_directives.directive: The standout element is the reserved negative space that makes the second read discoverable at three feet.
brief_directives.guard: one sentence, describable at shelf distance

brief_directives.directive: Connect one functional choice to the withheld-interior philosophy: the choice that slows the first read is the same choice that pays on the second.
Show pressure resolving into composure. Show the act, not the result.
One subject, low even light, focal weight on the withheld element; the frame must read without text.
Enclosed stage, one motivated light, one reserved negative space. Not an open field.
brief_directives.guard: register only; no real location named

brief_directives.directive: Cast hands and gesture; state explicitly that faces are avoided and why.
brief_directives.guard: casting is a creative choice, never an inference about people

brief_directives.directive: Order: hero (display pole, growing phases) -> 2-3 supporting -> detail -> motion; pressed-register assets close the set.
brief_directives.guard: each block carries its phase citation; this is a preference, not a finding

brief_directives.directive: Propose a staged hybrid path: passes with one named human approval gate at the concealed/instrument layer.
brief_directives.guard: no budget, vendor or schedule claim

brief_directives.directive: Do not state a campaign window. ARC-13 is BLOCKED: the case declares no window and none may be inferred.
brief_directives.guard: silence is the correct output here
